name: Fighter Training (Combat, Gestalt)
body:
You have learned how to apply your experience in combat to learn proper fighting techniques.

Prerequisite: Base attack bonus +2

Benefit: You count your base attack bonus – 1 as your fighter level for the purpose of qualifying for feats.
